scope: Native RTX4090 full bounded roadmap policy stage; review does not train or rerun policies.

validation.verification_scope: logged arithmetic, frozen decisions, joint function counts and cost inclusion; not a PDE proof

design.warning: Repeated policy variants, coefficient choices and target tracks are paired queries, not independent evidence.

conformal.guarantee_scope: marginal function-level coverage under exchangeability and a fixed score
conformal.exchangeability_scope: User-declared distributional assumption only; roadmap includes unseen physics and distribution shifts, so default is unsupported
conformal.teacher_scope: Calibration uses reference-refinement uncertainty estimates, not proved error bounds; no certified PDE error coverage

bootstrap.unit: independent field; training seeds crossed; repeated queries averaged within cells
bootstrap.interval_scope: descriptive paired crossed-cluster bootstrap; no population guarantee

formal_fallback_timing_confound.review_conclusion: No neural benefit or supported amortization. All outputs use identical classical fallback; baseline-first/variant-last order, especially first-call overhead, confounds the apparent saving. Excluding first endpoint is diagnostic, not a replacement predeclared benchmark.
